evidence.title: Sample Firm
evidence.excerpt: Sample Firm helps Ontario families resolve complex parenting and support disputes. We prepare each matter carefully and explain the available steps. Request a confidential consultation.

evidence.title: About the Firm
evidence.excerpt: Our lawyers have practised family law for more than twenty years. We focus on practical advice, careful preparation and clear communication with clients.

evidence.title: Family Law
evidence.excerpt: We advise on parenting arrangements, child and spousal support, and property division. Our team works with clients across Ontario.

part1.statement: The site presents the firm as an Ontario family-law practice helping families navigate complex parenting and support matters through careful preparation and clear guidance.
part1.rationale: The homepage names the audience and matters, while the about and service pages reinforce preparation, communication and family-law scope.

elements.finding: The site addresses Ontario families facing complex parenting and support disputes.
elements.reason: The homepage names both the audience and the situations served.
elements.uncertainty: The captured pages do not establish which clients the firm prefers.

elements.finding: Family law is the stated practice focus, including parenting, support and property matters.
elements.reason: The homepage and service page explicitly list the focus and examples.
elements.uncertainty: Other practices outside the captured pages may exist.

elements.finding: The site offers careful preparation and explanation of available steps.
elements.reason: The homepage states these service commitments but does not describe their full delivery.
elements.uncertainty: Actual client experience was not assessed.

elements.finding: The site says it explains available steps and provides practical advice.
elements.reason: The wording names useful process benefits but gives limited detail.

elements.finding: The emphasis on clear communication may be intended to reduce uncertainty for clients.
elements.reason: This is a cautious interpretation of the stated communication approach.
elements.uncertainty: The site does not explicitly promise an emotional outcome.

elements.finding: The site points to careful preparation, practical advice and clear communication.
elements.reason: These are stated reasons, but the site does not establish comparative advantage.
elements.uncertainty: No competitor or client research was conducted.

elements.finding: The about page states that the lawyers have practised family law for more than twenty years.
elements.reason: The experience statement is explicit on the captured page.
elements.uncertainty: The statement was not independently verified.

elements.finding: The three captured pages reinforce family-law focus and careful client guidance.
elements.reason: The homepage, about page and service page share a related emphasis.
elements.uncertainty: This is limited to three captured pages, not the whole site.

visualFindings.finding: The homepage screenshot shows the firm name and family-law message in the opening viewport.

directions.label: Complex parenting matters
directions.audienceSituation: Ontario families navigating complex parenting disputes
directions.possibleStatement: Focused family-law guidance for complex parenting disputes, grounded in careful preparation and clear communication.
directions.communicationImplication: Give parenting disputes a prominent route and explain the first steps in plain language.
directions.clientExpectation: A structured discussion of parenting concerns and available next steps.
directions.tradeoff: A narrower emphasis may make other family-law services less prominent.
validationQuestions: Which parenting matters are most aligned with the firm's work?
Do clients value the stated preparation and communication approach?
Which examples can the firm substantiate publicly?

directions.label: Clear process through family change
directions.audienceSituation: People seeking practical guidance through a family-law matter
directions.possibleStatement: Understand the steps ahead with practical family-law advice and clear communication.
directions.communicationImplication: Show the stages of a matter and what a first consultation can cover.
directions.clientExpectation: A clearer explanation of process and questions to consider.
directions.tradeoff: Process detail requires ongoing review to stay accurate and useful.
validationQuestions: Which process questions recur in consultations?
What can the firm safely explain before learning case details?
Would clients find a process guide useful?

directions.label: Keep the current breadth
directions.audienceSituation: Families with different parenting, support or property concerns
directions.possibleStatement: Family-law advice for parenting, support and property matters, with careful preparation and clear guidance.
directions.communicationImplication: Keep broad service coverage while making each matter pathway easy to find.
directions.clientExpectation: A clear route to information about the relevant family-law issue.
directions.tradeoff: A broad message may be less specific to any one matter.
validationQuestions: Does the current range reflect the matters the firm wants?
Which service areas need clearer entry points?
Does the current message match the firm's intended direction?

limitations: These options are hypotheses based on the captured website, not market-tested recommendations.
